specification.selection: positive net stressed development return, >=30 trades, <=10% drawdown, no stale marks; rank return/drawdown

limitations: Muhurat/special nonstandard-hour sessions are excluded from normal-session trading
Years before 2025 and after 2026 are not verified here; calendar updates must use exchange circulars
Amendments after checked_on require refreshing this file
